Pulse 0.8.1

What's new:
- Watchlist and share-card trend lines now follow the extended-hours setting: US pre-market and post-market sessions render as compressed gray wings with subtle separators at the 9:30 / 16:00 ET boundaries, matching the detail chart.
- Fixed pre-market trend lines collapsing into a short segment on the right of the chart. Longbridge minute history now backfills the prior regular session whenever extended-hours rows crowd it out of the latest page.
- Sharing a K-line chart now produces a true candlestick card of exactly the visible zoom window — bodies, wicks, volume band, and session tinting — with the window's date range shown in exchange time next to the period name.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.8.1.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
